001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.HashMap;
005import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import java.util.Random;
009
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.RepLevel;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Pair;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.TimeoutTracker;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.WeightedRandomPicker;
019
020public class FactionHostilityManager extends BaseEventManager {
021
022        public static String getConflictId(FactionAPI a, FactionAPI b) {
023                String id1 = a.getId();
024                String id2 = b.getId();
025                if (id1.compareTo(id2) < 0) {
026                        return id1 + "_" + id2;
027                }
028                return id2 + "_" + id1;
029        }
030        
031        public static final String KEY = "$core_factionHostilityManager";
032        
033        public static final float TIMEOUT_AFTER_ENDING = 30f;
034        public static final float CHECK_DAYS = 10f;
035        public static final float CHECK_PROB = 0.5f;
036        
037        public static FactionHostilityManager getInstance() {
038                Object test = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
039                return (FactionHostilityManager) test; 
040        }
041        
042        public FactionHostilityManager() {
043                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
044        }
045        
046        public boolean areHostilitiesOngoing(FactionAPI a, FactionAPI b) {
047                FactionHostilityIntel intel = getHostilties(a, b);
048                return intel != null && !intel.isEnding();
049        }
050        
051        public FactionHostilityIntel getHostilties(FactionAPI a, FactionAPI b) {
052                String id = getConflictId(a, b);
053                for (EveryFrameScript s : getActive()) {
054                        FactionHostilityIntel intel = (FactionHostilityIntel) s;
055                        if (intel.getId().equals(id)) {
056                                return intel;
057                        }
058                }
059                return null;
060        }
061        
062        public List<FactionHostilityIntel> getHostilitiesInvolving(FactionAPI faction) {
063                List<FactionHostilityIntel> result = new ArrayList<FactionHostilityIntel>();
064                for (EveryFrameScript s : getActive()) {
065                        FactionHostilityIntel intel = (FactionHostilityIntel) s;
066                        if (intel.getOne() == faction || intel.getTwo() == faction) {
067                                result.add(intel);
068                        }
069                }
070                return result;
071        }
072        
073        
074        @Override
075        protected int getMinConcurrent() {
076                List<FactionAPI> factions = getEligibleFactions(true);
077                
078                float mult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("minFactionHostilitiesMult");
079                return (int) Math.ceil(factions.size() * mult);
080        }
081        
082        @Override
083        protected int getMaxConcurrent() {
084                List<FactionAPI> factions = getEligibleFactions(true);
085                
086                float mult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("maxFactionHostilitiesMult");
087                return (int) Math.ceil(factions.size() * mult);
088        }
089        
090        protected List<FactionAPI> getEligibleFactions(boolean checkNumMarkets) {
091                List<FactionAPI> factions = Global.getSector().getAllFactions();
092                List<FactionAPI> result = new ArrayList<FactionAPI>();
093                for (int i = 0; i < factions.size(); i++) {
094                        FactionAPI faction = factions.get(i);
095                        if (!faction.getCustom().optBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_ENGAGES_IN_HOSTILITIES)) {
096                                continue;
097                        }
098                        if (isExcluded(faction.getId())) continue;
099                        
100                        if (faction.isPlayerFaction()) continue;
101                        
102                        if (checkNumMarkets) {
103                                int count = Misc.getFactionMarkets(faction).size();
104                                if (count <= 0) continue;
105                        }
106                        
107                        result.add(faction);
108                }
109                
110                return result;
111        }
112        
113        
114        @Override
115        protected float getBaseInterval() {
116                return CHECK_DAYS;
117        }
118        
119        public void startHostilities(String a, String b) {
120                startHostilities(Global.getSector().getFaction(a), Global.getSector().getFaction(b));
121                
122        }
123        public void startHostilities(FactionAPI a, FactionAPI b) {
124                if (areHostilitiesOngoing(a, b)) return;
125                
126                FactionHostilityIntel intel = new FactionHostilityIntel(a, b);
127                addActive(intel);
128        }
129
130        protected Random random = new Random();
131        
132        @Override
133        protected EveryFrameScript createEvent() {
134                if (random.nextFloat() < CHECK_PROB) return null;
135                
136                Pair<FactionAPI, FactionAPI> pick = pickFactions();
137                if (pick == null) return null;
138                
139                FactionHostilityIntel intel = new FactionHostilityIntel(pick.one, pick.two);
140                
141                return intel;
142        }
143        
144        public void notifyRecentlyEnded(String id) {
145                recentlyEnded.add(id, TIMEOUT_AFTER_ENDING);
146        }
147        
148        public TimeoutTracker<String> getRecentlyEnded() {
149                return recentlyEnded;
150        }
151
152        public boolean isExcluded(String factionId) {
153                return exclude != null && exclude.contains(factionId);
154        }
155        
156        public void setExcluded(String factionId, boolean excluded) {
157                if (excluded) {
158                        if (exclude == null) {
159                                exclude = new LinkedHashSet<>();
160                        }
161                        exclude.add(factionId);
162                } else {
163                        if (exclude != null) {
164                                exclude.remove(factionId);
165                                if (exclude.isEmpty()) {
166                                        exclude = null;
167                                }
168                        }
169                }
170        }
171        
172        
173        protected LinkedHashSet<String> exclude;
174        protected TimeoutTracker<String> recentlyEnded = new TimeoutTracker<String>();
175        @Override
176        public void advance(float amount) {
177                //amount *= 100f;
178                super.advance(amount);
179                
180                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
181                recentlyEnded.advance(days);
182        }
183
184        protected Pair<FactionAPI, FactionAPI> pickFactions() {
185                List<FactionAPI> factions = new ArrayList<FactionAPI>();
186                Map<FactionAPI, Integer> marketCounts = new HashMap<FactionAPI, Integer>();
187                
188                for (FactionAPI faction : getEligibleFactions(false)) {
189                        int count = Misc.getFactionMarkets(faction).size();
190                        if (count <= 0) continue;
191                        marketCounts.put(faction, count);
192                        
193                        factions.add(faction);
194                }
195                
196                WeightedRandomPicker<FactionAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FactionAPI>(random);
197                
198                boolean weighCommissionedMore = false;
199                FactionAPI commission = Misc.getCommissionFaction();
200                if (commission != null && getHostilitiesInvolving(commission).isEmpty()) {
201                        weighCommissionedMore = true;
202                }
203                
204                for (FactionAPI faction : factions) {
205                        float w = 1f;
206                        if (commission == faction && weighCommissionedMore) {
207                                w = factions.size();
208                        }
209                        picker.add(faction, w);
210                }
211                
212                FactionAPI one = picker.pick();
213                if (one == null) return null;
214                
215                picker.clear();
216                for (FactionAPI faction : factions) {
217                        if (faction == one) continue;
218                        if (faction.isHostileTo(one)) continue;
219                        if (faction.isAtWorst(one, RepLevel.COOPERATIVE)) continue;
220                        
221                        String id = getConflictId(one, faction);
222                        if (recentlyEnded.contains(id)) continue;
223                        
224                        float w = marketCounts.get(faction);
225                        picker.add(faction, w);
226                }
227                
228                FactionAPI two = picker.pick();
229                if (two == null) return null;
230                
231                return new Pair<FactionAPI, FactionAPI>(one, two);
232                
233        }
234        
235}
